facts.text: The Torero Promise offers an admission pathway to the University of San Diego for students graduating from participating diocesan high schools.

sources.title: Torero Promise - Undergraduate Admission - University of San Diego
sources.quote: The Torero Promise is a partnership between the University of San Diego and participating diocesan high schools in San Diego and San Bernardino that provides eligible students with a clear pathway to earn admission by meeting the program requirements.
